subject: Formal Symbolic Logic & Model Theory
topic: First-Order Predicate Logic: Quantifiers, Variable Binding, and Semantics
syllabus_context: Part II: First-Order Logic (FOL). Predicates, individual constants, variables, universal quantifier (forall), existential quantifier (exists), free vs bound variables, scope of quantifiers, model-theoretic structures M = <D, I>, truth under an assignment, valid inference rules (Universal Instantiation, Existential Generalization), and soundness of the deductive system.
declared_learning_objective: Translate complex English statements into first-order predicate logic with nested quantifiers, specify model structures M = <D, I> to evaluate the truth of quantified formulas, prove validity of quantifier inference rules, and evaluate pathological edge cases involving empty domains and vacuous quantification.

provenance.source: Standard Academic Formal Symbolic Logic Lecture Series

recording_quality.known_observability_limitations: Formal logical notation, quantifier scoping brackets, and set-theoretic domain models written on whiteboard.
